metadata.title: Endpoint capacity at strictly stable minimal boundaries:Gaussian layers and Schwarzschild deficits
metadata.abstract: Let $(M^n,\mathfrak g)$, $3\le n\le7$, be a one-ended asymptotically flat manifold whose boundary $\Sigma$ is a connected, strictly stable, outermost minimal hypersurface. As $p\downarrow1$, the $p$-capacity of $\Sigma$ converges to its area, by a theorem of Fogagnolo and Mazzieri. We establish a higher-order asymptotic expansion governed by a single function on $\Sigma$: the positive solution $g$ of the reciprocal Jacobi equation $Jg=g^{-1}$. After a universal term, the first correction is determined by the average of $\log g$, and the capacitary potential drops from one to zero across a Gaussian boundary layer of width $g\sqrt{p-1}$; under the normalized energy measure, the logarithm of the gradient has limiting variance $\frac12$ plus the variance of $\log g$. In dimension three, assuming in addition that $R_{\mathfrak g}+|\mathrm{II}|^2\ge0$ along $\Sigma$, we identify the capacity deficit of $\Sigma$ relative to the Schwarzschild horizon of the same area at order $p-1$: it is nonnegative, vanishes exactly when the induced metric of $\Sigma$ is round and $R_{\mathfrak g}+|\mathrm{II}|^2\equiv0$, and controls the deviation of $g$ from a constant through a relative-entropy identity.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 对3至7维单端渐近平坦流形的连通严格稳定最外极小边界，求 p→1 时 p-容量的高阶展开，以 Jg=g^{-1} 的正解控制高斯边界层及首个修正。
analysis.breakthrough: 把容量趋于面积的零阶极限推进为可辨识边界稳定性的高阶缺额。
analysis.limitations: 三维 Schwarzschild 缺额的非负及等号结论另需边界上 R+|II|²≥0；不能扩展为整体 Schwarzschild 刚性。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
